title: part.rs: byte ranges stored as (u32, u32) not (usize, usize) — correct for cross-platform serde stability
description: ParsedPart stores header_range and body_range as (u32, u32) not (usize, usize). The comment explains: u32 guarantees identical serialized representation on 32-bit and 64-bit hosts. This is the correct choice for a Serialize+Deserialize type that may be stored (e.g., in a database or on the wire) and later used on a different architecture. A future contributor might 'simplify' to usize to avoid the as usize casts in decode.rs. That would break serialization compatibility across platforms without any compile-time warning.
